861:t_037:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Your flying is superb, $$アルト$$. The sky I share with you is magnificent.」

861:t_037:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「Thank you very much, Major $$グラハム$$.」

861:t_037:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「When I fly side by side with you, it feels like we've become a pair of wings.」

861:t_037:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Oh? Then does that make me your wing?」

861:t_037:8.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Hahaha! Consider it a return gift for your romantic words.」

861:t_037:9.en:
$$グラハム$$
「As a Virgo, I'm quite the romantic myself... May I say a few words?」

861:t_038:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am a winged one from the heavens... I have come to welcome a beautiful one who has finished the game.」

861:t_038:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come now, $$レア・イグラー$$... Spend sinful days with me in $$アルテア$$...」

861:t_038:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll have you know, I'm a man!」

861:t_038:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Beauty has nothing to do with man or woman. Come... forget the game, and spend a night of depravity and pleasure with me...」

861:t_038:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Y-you there...! If you want to help me out, get back in the game right away! Please! Hurry!」

861:t_039:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「All right...! Here, I can practice singing without anyone getting in my way!」

861:t_039:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Here I go, 'I Am $$ガムリン$$'! Listen to my song!!」

861:t_039:7.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「What? You're saying that hearing my song wouldn't count as rest?」

861:t_039:8.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I see! My song fires up your heart that much! Thank you, players! I look forward to the day we meet again!」

861:t_040:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Player departure confirmed. Beginning observation as a subject of special caution.」

861:t_040:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Furthermore, if the subject does not return to the game within three hours, we will promptly detain...」

861:t_040:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Get a grip, $$ブレラ$$! Don't mistake who you're dealing with!」

861:t_040:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...Sorry. I seem to have been having a bad dream.」

861:t_040:8.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Leave the rest to me. Players, everyone, take a good rest with $$ランカ$$'s songs.」

861:t_040:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「You sure turn on a dime...」

861:t_041:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Game over! Let's do that one last thing, $$ヴィラル$$!」

861:t_041:4.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That...? Fine, it might be fun...!」

861:t_041:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「Hope and despair, future and past! The final battle where two paths twist and cross!」

861:t_041:6.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Smash enemy machines with fists of steel! Seize victory with your own wisdom!」

861:t_041:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「The Super Robots' final battle! '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen'!」

861:t_041:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「What the hell do you take this game for!!」

861:t_041:9.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「This happens every time, so I'm not going to call it out anymore, but...」

861:t_041:10.en:
$$ニア$$
「Thank you for your hard work too, everyone. Rest well, eat plenty, and please play again!」

861:t_042:3.en:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Already over!? It's only just getting started!!」

861:t_042:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「What's wrong, $$アーテンボロー$$? You seem oddly fired up...」

861:t_042:5.en:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Heh heh! I was cramped up until now because of grown-up circumstances! With a face and voice in, my motivation is a hundred times higher!」

861:t_042:6.en:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「I might as well take over from $$ダヤッカ$$ as Captain!」

861:t_042:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Can you do it, $$アーテンボロー$$?」

861:t_042:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「There you have it, $$アーテンボロー$$. When it's time to rest, let's rest properly.」

861:t_043:3.en:
$$リーロン$$
「$$ロージェノム$$, what do you think of this game?」

861:t_043:4.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「A video game is the embodiment of human desire. Once that desire is satisfied, its existence is established as something useful.」

861:t_043:5.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「That is the natural order of this world... and this title is no exception.」

861:t_043:6.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「So what does that mean...?」

861:t_043:7.en:
$$リーロン$$
「It means whoever has the most fun wins.」

861:t_043:8.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「I wish to meet you again.」

861:t_044:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Another day, another scramble! We keep fighting for this planet's tomorrow!」

861:t_044:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But the enemies closing in are all tough ones! Seriously, seriously, at this rate the world is going to collapse!」

861:t_044:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Please, Player! Lend us your strength! Let's win Earth's future together!」

861:t_044:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z', 'Song of the Distant Galaxy'!」

861:t_044:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's do a Lightning Kick together with you!」

861:t_045:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Hi, everyone! $$タカヤ$$ here! Wow...! This time I'm running the whole show all by myself! $$コーチ$$, Big Sis! $$ノリコ$$ is going to grow up a little more!」

861:t_045:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Ahem... now then, let's go over kill counts. First, a pilot who shoots down an enemy has their kill count go up.」

861:t_045:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The pilot with the highest kill count in the unit becomes the Top Ace, and gets a bonus to Morale when sortieing~!」

861:t_045:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Top Ace... the number-one star shining in the unit! All right! I'll aim for the top with hard work and guts! Player, cheer me on, okay!」

861:t_046:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Hi, everyone! $$タカヤ$$ here! Wow...! This time I'm running the whole show all by myself! $$コーチ$$, Big Sis! $$ノリコ$$ is going to grow up a little more!」

861:t_046:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Ahem... now then, let's go over kill counts. First, a pilot who shoots down an enemy has their kill count go up.」

861:t_046:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Once this kill count goes over 80...」

861:t_046:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You become an ace pilot, everyone's dream! On top of the bonuses to Morale and funds when sortieing, you even get an Ace Bonus with a special effect!」

861:t_046:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So, I'll leave it to you, Player, to find out who has what kind of bonus~! ...Wait, what was my Ace Bonus again...?」

861:t_047:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「3rd Super Robot Wars Z! Strategy Lecture~!」

861:t_047:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Now then, a letter from one of the good kids playing SRW, a big SRW fan in Aichi Prefecture...」

861:t_047:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We received a postcard asking, 'What is the $$Ｚチップ$$ that appeared starting this time?'」

861:t_047:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Oh! A postcard! Email submissions are on the rise these days, so I'm glad to see one!」

861:t_047:9.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Right. It's been so long that I was surprised too.」

861:t_047:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I send in my submissions on postcards whenever I can, too! I think your own handwriting conveys the hard work and guts you put into your letter!」

861:t_047:12.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Plus, you can draw illustrations too!」

861:t_047:13.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノリコ$$... it's almost time...」

861:t_047:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Awww! But I still have so much to talk about!」

861:t_047:15.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We'll answer the SRW fan's question another time.」

861:t_048:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「3rd Super Robot Wars Z! Strategy Lecture~!」
